title: Consecutive non-square non-primitive pairs in a finite field
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power and write \[ θ_q := \frac{φ(q-1)}{q-1}. \] If $θ_q < \tfrac{1}{3}$, or if $θ_q = \tfrac{1}{3}$ and $q \notin \{7,13,19,25,37\}$, then the finite field $\F$ contains a pair of consecutive elements that are both non-square and non-primitive. This extends a result of Jarso and Trudgian for prime fields $\Fp$, where the same conclusion was obtained under the stronger condition $θ_p \le \tfrac{1}{4}$.
